name: Stauffer's Original Animal Crackers
whyItWorks: Traditional animal crackers are semi-sweet, low in fat, and low in sugar compared to standard cookies. Their dense, tender crumb softens rapidly, making them gentle on sensitive intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: A nostalgic, comforting snack when craving something slightly sweet without dairy butter or chocolate.
watchOuts: Avoid frosted animal cookies with heavy hydrogenated fat glazes.
